definition.text: A good journey, a female member of the church at Philippi. She was one who laboured much with Paul in the gospel. He exhorts her to be of one mind with Syntyche (Phil. 4:2). From this it seems they had been at variance with each other.

works.title: Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume 1: The Apostolic Fathers with Justin Martyr and Irenaeus

chapters.title: Chapter VII.—Exhortation to consistency of conduct
